basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D side-scrolling adventure terrain tile. Input image 1 is ONLY a linework/cel-shading/style reference, do NOT draw its person, weapon, costume or background. Match the project's clear ink outlines, 2-3 gentle cel shades and upper-left material lighting. Clean original webtoon game art for children. Low-to-moderate contrast in the fill so characters read clearly; crisp flat walkable tops. Orthographic straight-on material texture, no perspective, no scenes, no characters, no props, no text, lettering, logos, border frame, vignette, global gradient or watermark.

materials.dock: Warm golden-brown harbor timber. Broad horizontal planks, quiet dark grain strokes and small inset iron nail marks. Honey upper lip, dark umber underside. Base #8a5a3a / highlights #b98455 / shadow #5a3622.
materials.deck: Weathered dark ship-deck timber with broad horizontal planks, subtle charcoal grain, sparse inset bronze nail marks. Warm medium-brown walkable lip and deep umber underside. Base #6e4a36 / highlights #9a6b4b / shadow #45291d.
materials.reef: Soft teal sea-worn limestone reef, large rounded mineral patches and tiny muted rose coral inclusions, no water scene. Pale seafoam walkable surface. Base #5d7f80 / highlights #8fb3a6 / shadow #3c5a5f.
materials.coral: Lavender-blue reef rock with embedded small pink and turquoise coral flecks, no fragile protrusions or branches outside the rectangle. Pale coral-pink walkable surface. Base #6a6f8e / highlights #9aa2c3 / shadow #464b6b.
materials.whale: Gentle blue-gray sea-smoothed island stone, broad rounded polished patches and subtle slate marks, no animal body or face. Pale blue seafoam walkable lip. Base #5d7c87 / highlights #8eaab0 / shadow #3f5a66.
materials.basalt: Dark plum-gray volcanic basalt, large broad polygonal stones and sparse warm amber mineral veins, no dripping lava or fire. Warm orange walkable lip. Base #4b3a44 / highlights #6e5560 / shadow #2e2229.
materials.crystal: Deep indigo-violet crystalline rock, broad understated angular mineral facets, occasional small pale lavender inlays, no tall freestanding crystals. Pale lavender walkable lip. Base #45486e / highlights #6c70a3 / shadow #2c2e4c.
materials.cloud: Pale blue-white solid cloud platform material, broad soft overlapping puffs defined by clean gentle blue-gray ink contours. Ivory white walkable lip, powder-blue underside. Base #d9e6ea / highlights #ffffff / shadow #a9bfc8.
materials.village: Warm ochre-brown village stone masonry, broad slightly rounded staggered stone blocks, thin dark mortar, a quiet moss-green walkable cap. Base #9c7a5c / highlights #c9a47d / shadow #6d533e.
materials.warehouse: Aged warm brown warehouse timber, broad horizontal boards, quiet irregular grain and sparse inset dark iron nail marks. Golden brown flat walkable lip. Base #7a5a40 / highlights #a77e58 / shadow #4c3626.
materials.sand: Compact golden sandy coast rock, broad softly rounded sandstone patches with a few muted turquoise mineral grains, no ocean or scenery. Pale cream-gold walkable lip. Base #b59b74 / highlights #dcc59a / shadow #8a7354.
materials.shadow: Quiet dark violet castle masonry, large staggered stone blocks and restrained pale lavender edges, no horror faces or symbols. Muted lavender walkable lip. Base #3c3a56 / highlights #5c5a80 / shadow #25233a.
materials.jungle: Rich brown packed jungle earth, broad low-contrast soil clumps, sparse small stone flecks and short root lines. Moss-green horizontal walkable turf cap, foliage remains within the rectangular strip. Base #6a4b33 / highlights #8e6a4a / shadow #45301f.
materials.temple: Warm ochre carved temple masonry, broad clean stone blocks with a few simple non-religious geometric incisions, no inscriptions or deity imagery. Pale golden limestone walkable lip. Base #b08c64 / highlights #d8b98b / shadow #7e6346.
materials.garden: Warm brown soft garden soil, broad quiet clumps with sparse pale pebbles, no large roots or scenery. Fresh gentle green flat turf cap, a few tiny pink petal accents within the strip. Base #7a5b40 / highlights #9e7a58 / shadow #51392a.
materials.tower: Cool deep slate-indigo tower masonry, broad sturdy stone blocks, quiet gold-gray mineral inlays with no symbols. Pale blue-gray walkable lip. Base #3f4566 / highlights #5d6690 / shadow #282d47.
materials.kingdom: Warm pale ivory palace stone masonry, broad clean limestone blocks and very restrained gold and dusty teal inlays, no ornamental crests or text. Gentle golden ivory walkable lip. Base #d6cbb6 / highlights #f3ead8 / shadow #a89c86.
